title: Usability and Storytelling: Bookmarks, Tooltips, Navigation, Drillthrough

header.html: Configure bookmarks; Create custom tooltips; Edit and configure interactions between visuals; Configure navigation for a report; Apply sorting to visuals; Configure sync slicers; Group and layer visuals by using the Selection pane; Configure drillthrough navigation, including pages, filters, and buttons
the official PL-300 study guide (skills measured as of April 20, 2026)

html:
1Drillthrough and its look-alikes

Drillthrough sends the viewer from a summary to a detail page that is already filtered to the item they picked.

Feature One-line difference
Drill down Moves down a hierarchy inside the same visual, such as Year, Quarter, Month
Drill through Jumps to another page, filtered by the selected item
Cross-filtering Selecting a data point filters or highlights the other visuals on the same page
Step What to do
1. Create the page Add a detail page and give it a clear name
2. Add the field Drag the field into the Drillthrough filters well; Power BI adds a Back button automatically
3. Use it Viewers right-click a data point, choose Drillthrough, then the page
4. Or use a button Add a button whose Action type is Drill through

The well also offers a Keep all filters switch, which passes the other filters of the source page along. Cross-report drillthrough works when both reports are in the same workspace, the target report has Cross-report drillthrough turned on, and the field names and types match.

Exam tip

. Drill down stays in the visual, drill through goes to another page, cross-filtering stays on the page. If a scenario says "open a detail page for the selected item", the answer is drillthrough.

2Bookmarks

A bookmark saves the state of a report page so that one click returns to it. It captures the current page, filters, slicers, visual selection, sort, drill location, visibility of objects and focus mode. Open the Bookmarks pane on the View tab.

Option What it controls
Data Filters, slicers, sort and drill location
Display Which objects are shown or hidden, and focus mode
Current page The page that is showing; turned off, the viewer stays on the current page
All visuals or Selected visuals Whether the bookmark affects every visual or only the selected ones

Related features:

  • Groups keep related bookmarks together in the pane.
  • Slideshow: the View button in the Bookmarks pane steps through the bookmarks in order.
  • Button action Bookmark: a button runs a chosen bookmark.
  • Bookmark navigator: one button for every bookmark, added from Insert, Buttons, Navigator.
  • A slicer added after a bookmark was saved is cleared when that bookmark is applied.
Exam tip

. A bookmark restores a saved view of the same report; drillthrough opens a page filtered by the chosen item. Data, Display and Current page can each be switched off for a bookmark.

3Navigation, buttons and tooltips

Navigation is built from navigators and buttons. Add them from the Insert tab, Buttons.

Item What it does
Page navigator One button for every page, built automatically
Bookmark navigator One button for every bookmark
Button A shape with one action

A button action can be Back, Bookmark, Drill through, Page navigation, Q and A, Web URL, Apply all slicers or Clear all slicers. The destination of a page navigation button can be conditional, driven by a field with fx.

A custom tooltip is a small report page that appears when the viewer hovers over a visual.

Step Setting
1. Page size In Format page, set the page size to Tooltip
2. Page information Turn on Allow use as tooltip
3. Tooltip fields well Add the field that the tooltip page should filter by
4. Visuals Build small visuals on the page
5. Set it on a visual Format visual, Tooltips, Type Report page, then choose the page

Tooltips are not interactive: the viewer can hover, not click.

Exam tip

. A tooltip page needs page size Tooltip and Allow use as tooltip turned on; then each visual must use Type Report page. Skipping the last step leaves the default tooltip.

4Interactions, sorting and sync slicers

Interactions decide what happens to other visuals when you select a data point. Select the source visual, choose Edit interactions on the Format tab, then click an icon on each target visual.

Icon Effect on the target visual
Filter Shows only the selected data
Highlight Shows all data with the selected part highlighted
None No effect

The default is cross-filtering or cross-highlighting. Line charts, scatter charts and maps are filtered, not highlighted. Drilling down in one visual filters the others only when Apply drill down filters to is set to Entire page.

Sorting. On a visual, open More options, choose Sort axis, pick a field and sort ascending or descending. In the model, Sort by column fixes a text column that sorts alphabetically: sort Month Name by Month Number. Each name must map to one number.

Sync slicers. Open the Sync slicers pane on the View tab.

Column Meaning
Sync The slicer's selections apply on that page
Visible The slicer is shown on that page

A synced slicer that is not visible still filters its page. In Advanced options, a group name syncs separate slicers that share the name, with options to sync field changes and filter changes.

Exam tip

. Sync controls where the selection applies; Visible controls where the slicer appears. Sync on with Visible off filters a page silently.

5The Selection pane

The Selection pane lists every object on the page. Open it on the View tab.

Task How
Layer order Objects higher in the list are in front; drag to reorder
Show or hide The eye icon hides an object without deleting it
Group Group several objects to move, resize or hide them together
Rename Give clear names to find objects quickly
Tab order Sets the keyboard order; remove decorative items

Bookmarks save the eye icon state through the Display option, which makes view switching possible.

Exam tip

. The top of the Selection pane list is the front layer, and bookmarks save which objects are hidden. Grouping does not change interactions.

6Exam Q&A

6.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1Users on a summary page want to right-click a customer and open a detail page that shows only that customer. What should the author do on the detail page?

  • ATurn on Allow use as tooltip in the Page information
  • BAdd a slicer for Customer and sync it to all pages
  • CAdd the Customer field to the Drillthrough filters well
  • DSet the page size to Tooltip and add a Customer filter
Show the answer

Answer: C. A field in the Drillthrough filters well makes the page a drillthrough target that is filtered to the item chosen on the source page.

S2An author wants buttons that switch one page between a chart view and a table view by showing and hiding visuals. What should the author combine?

  • ATwo bookmarks that save visibility, and buttons that run them
  • BA drillthrough page with an automatic Back button for each view
  • CSync slicers with the Visible column turned on for each view
  • DAn Edit interactions setting of None on both visuals
Show the answer

Answer: A. Bookmarks capture the Display state set in the Selection pane, and buttons with the Bookmark action run them.

S3An author set a page to the Tooltip size and turned on Allow use as tooltip, but hovering over the visual still shows the default tooltip. What step is missing?

  • AAdd the tooltip page to the Selection pane as a group
  • BTurn on Personalize visuals so viewers see the tooltip
  • CAdd a Drillthrough filters field and a Back button
  • DSet the tooltip Type to Report page on the visual
Show the answer

Answer: D. Each visual must be pointed at the tooltip page with Type Report page, otherwise it keeps the default tooltip.

S4A Year slicer on page 1 must filter pages 2 and 3, and no slicer should appear on those pages. How should the author set pages 2 and 3 in the Sync slicers pane?

  • ASync off and Visible on for pages 2 and 3
  • BSync on and Visible off for pages 2 and 3
  • CSync on and Visible on for pages 2 and 3
  • DSync off and Visible off for pages 2 and 3
Show the answer

Answer: B. Sync applies the selection on the page and Visible off hides the slicer, and a synced slicer that is hidden still filters.

S5Selecting a bar in a column chart should filter a matrix on the same page but leave a card unchanged. What should the author do?

  • AGroup the card and the matrix together in the Selection pane
  • BTurn off the Visible column for the card in Sync slicers
  • CSend the card to the back layer in the Selection pane
  • DUse Edit interactions on the chart and set the card to None
Show the answer

Answer: D. Edit interactions with None on the card stops the chart from affecting it, while grouping, layers and sync do not control interactions.

S6A column chart lists months as April, August, December and so on. The author wants calendar order. What should the author do?

  • ASort the axis in descending order on the visual
  • BRename the months with a number prefix in the source
  • CSet Month Name to sort by Month Number in the model
  • DAdd Month Number to the Legend well of the chart
Show the answer

Answer: C. Sort by column in the model sorts the month names by their month numbers in every visual.

6.2 Recall questions

R1Which three options can a bookmark include or leave out?

Show the answer

Data, Display and Current page.

R2What are the three interaction icons?

Show the answer

Filter, Highlight and None.

R3Which page size and Page information switch make a tooltip page?

Show the answer

Tooltip size, and Allow use as tooltip.

R4What does the Visible column in Sync slicers do?

Show the answer

It shows the slicer on that page.

R5Which end of the Selection pane list is the front layer?

Show the answer

The top.

R6Which feature jumps to another page filtered by the selected item?

Show the answer

Drillthrough.

7Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Drill features Drill down: inside the visual; drill through: another page; cross-filtering: same page
Drillthrough Field in the Drillthrough filters well; automatic Back button; right-click or button; cross-report: same workspace
Bookmarks Page, filters, slicers, sort, drill, visibility; options Data, Display, Current page; groups, slideshow
Navigation Page navigator, bookmark navigator, buttons with actions such as Back, Bookmark, Drill through
Tooltips Page size Tooltip; Allow use as tooltip; Type Report page; not interactive
Interactions Filter, Highlight, None; line charts, scatter charts and maps only filter
Sorting Sort axis on the visual; Sort by column in the model for month names
Sync slicers Sync applies the selection; Visible shows the slicer; hidden synced slicers still filter
Selection pane Top is front; eye icon saved by bookmarks; group; rename; tab order
